Stardew Valley is a singleplayer and multiplayer bird's-eye view and scrolling RPG, building, farming and life sim game.

As of March 2024,[5] the game is still being updated, with the latest version being Patch 1.6.15.[6]

Settings can only be changed when in-game or inside the startup_preferences file located in the configuration file(s) location.

No Menu Buttons[edit]

Menu is too zoomed in/offset
  1. Go to the configuration file(s) location.
  2. Edit startup_preferences.
  3. Change fullscreenResolutionX and fullscreenResolutionY to your screen resolution.
  4. Change <fullscreenResolutionX>2560</fullscreenResolutionX>< to <fullscreenResolutionX>1920</fullscreenResolutionX>.
  5. Change <fullscreenResolutionY>1440</fullscreenResolutionY> to <fullscreenResolutionY>1080</fullscreenResolutionY>.

Issues fixed[edit]

Game fails to launch on MacOS[edit]

Open terminal and run the command 'sudo chown -v “$USER” ~/.config' then restart your computer. This should correct the ownership of a folder that Stardew Valley needs to write under allowing the game to launch properly.[12]

Native Linux version fails to launch (Steam version)[13][edit]

In Steam, open the 'Properties' of the games entry, go to the 'Compatibility' tab, enable 'Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool' and select 'Legacy runtime 1.0' in the drop-down list.

Native Linux version stuck on "Connecting to online services' in Co-Op (Online) option[14][edit]

1.The package 'execstack' needs to be installed from your distributions repository.

Fedora: sudo dnf install execstack

Ubuntu: sudo apt install execstack

Arch: yay -S execstack

2. Navigate to the Stardew Valley folder:

i.e /home/user/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/

Then, in a terminal, run the following command: execstack -c libGalaxy64.so && execstack -c libGalaxyCSharpGlue.so.

SMAPI[edit]

The mod loader for Stardew Valley. Required for most types of mod.

Easy to install and use.
Compatible with Linux/Mac/Windows. Works fine with GOG and Steam achievements.

Content Patcher[edit]

Loads content packs that change the game's data, images, and maps without replacing XNB files and make changes dynamically based on many in-game details.

Great for easy mod creation. Including a API that let modders create custom tokens for content packs to use.
Require SMAPI to use.
